senses.gloss: BK0172 वंशी vaṁśī The dust particle visible in the rays of sun
RS0256 वनच्छनै vanacchanai Dried cow dung cakes obtained from forest area
DG0391 वनस्पति vanaspati One among 4 categories of medicinal plants; big trees having fruits but having rudimentary or modified flowers like Ficus bengalanesis
SV0304 वनस्पति vanaspati Those plants/ trees having only fruits (without visible flowers) such as vata, udumbara.
DG0382 वानस्पत्य vānaspatya One among 4 categories of medicinal plants; big trees having both fruits and flowers; e.g.: Mango tree
